title: Clique supersaturation under a chromatic constraint below the Turán threshold
summary: A central theme in extremal graph theory is the supersaturation problem, which investigates the minimum number of copies of a target subgraph forced by prescribed edge conditions. This line of research goes back to Rademacher and Erdős for triangles, and was later extended to cliques by Lovász and Simonovits in the regime above the Turán threshold. Mubayi further extended this theory to color-critical graphs.
